basic_details.job_title: Calicut University Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The University of Calicut has two contractual posts of Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer at the CDMRP Kannur Unit. The posts come under the Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) of its Department of Psychology. Applications on plain paper must reach the Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 on or before 6 December 2026 (4 pm). The essential qualification is M.Sc. Applied Psychology, and the consolidated pay is Rs. 27,500/- per month.

content_sections.heading: About the CDMRP, University of Calicut
content_sections.text: The Community Based Disability Management and Rehabilitation Programme (CDMRP) is a joint project of the Department of Psychology, University of Calicut and the Social Justice Department, Govt. of Kerala. These two Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer posts are in the programme's Kannur Unit. The Director-CDMRP, Department of Psychology, University of Calicut issued the vacancy notification on 24 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice does not give an application form. Candidates must write the application on plain paper. It must give their full bio-data and have the documents listed under Enclosures attached. Send the application to this address: Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635 . The application must reach this address on or before 6 December 2026, 4 pm. The notice does not name a postal mode, and it does not say what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, the Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer, with two vacancies. Both vacancies are at the CDMRP Kannur Unit. Essential qualification: M.Sc. Applied Psychology of Calicut University or its equivalent. Desirable experience: At least one year experience in the area of developmental disabilities, community mental health, coordinator of project. The notice lists this as desirable, not essential. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Mode of appointment: Contract. The notice says the post is "on contractual basis". It does not state the length of the contract. Consolidated pay: Rs. 27,500/- P.M. The notice does not mention any allowances. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Full bio-data on plain paper Passport size attested photograph Attested copies of mark sheets Attested copies of certificates Other necessary documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Director-CDMRP will process all the applications. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview before the selection committee. The notice does not give the interview date or the shortlisting criteria.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer at CDMRP?
faq.answer: There are two (2) vacancies, and both are at the CDMRP Kannur Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Director-CDMRP on or before 6 December 2026, 4 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Sc. Applied Psychology of Calicut University or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. Is experience compulsory?
faq.answer: No. At least one year of experience in the area of developmental disabilities, community mental health, or as a coordinator of a project is listed as desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Case Coordinator cum Liaison Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 27,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Write an application on plain paper giving your full bio-data. Attach an attested passport size photograph and attested copies of your mark sheets, certificates and other necessary documents. Send it to Director- CDMRP, Department of Psychology, Calicut University-PO, Pin-673635.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Director-CDMRP processes the applications, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The mode of appointment is contract, and the post is advertised "on contractual basis" under the CDMRP project.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the place of posting?
faq.answer: Both posts are at the CDMRP Kannur Unit.
